events.description: Multiple players from Pittsburgh Penguins (yellow/black) and New York Islanders (blue/orange) engage in a multi-person scrum in front of the Penguins' net, involving grappling, shoving, and punches; referees intervene to separate them throughout the sequence.

A Penguins player (No. 44, Letang) appears to deliver repeated strikes to an Isles player (No. 12, Bailey) who is on the ice and partially pinned by others, indicating targeting of a helpless opponent during the scrum.

Multiple players from Pittsburgh Penguins (yellow/black) and New York Islanders (blue/orange) engage in a multi-person scrum near the net, involving grappling, shoving, and helmet-to-helmet contact; referees intervene to separate them throughout the sequence.

A Penguins player (No. 44, Letang) appears to deliver a punch or elbow to an Islanders player who is on the ice and partially down, while others are engaged around him; this constitutes attacking a helpless victim during the ongoing fight.

Pittsburgh Penguins player #71 (Evgeni Malkin) and a New York Islanders player engage in a physical confrontation near the boards, with the referee intervening to separate them. The interaction involves grabbing and pushing, consistent with a hockey fight.
